title: Original toy method: retain selected columns
scientific_source: Self-contained fictional teaching example authored for this workflow. Rule R1: an input matrix and a binary column mask enter one selection operation. Rule R2: the output contains only the selected columns in their original order. No published paper or empirical result is represented.
mechanism: The input matrix has three rows and four columns. The mask [1, 0, 1, 0] selects columns one and three. A single selection operation produces a three-row, two-column output. The overview and enlarged detail show the same operation, not two successive operations.
must_show: Input matrix, column mask, one selection operation, and output matrix
An enlarged detail of that same selection operation, paired without arrows
The output preserves the order of columns one and three
must_not_show: Measured results or claims about a real paper
A second application of the selection operation
An arrow from the overview selection operation to its enlarged detail
